an5.23:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṃgu ca na ca sammāupeti kammāya
an5.23:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca jātarūpassa upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṃgu ca na ca sammāupeti kammāya
an5.23:1.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave jātarūpaṃ imehi pañcahi upakkilesehi vimuttaṃ hoti taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ mudu ca kammaniyaṃ ca pabhassaraṃ ca na ca pabhaṃgu sammāupeti kammāya
an5.23:1.6: yassakassaci pilandhanavikatiyā ākaṃkhati yadi muddikāya yadi kuṇḍalāya yadi gīveyyakena yadi suvaṇṇamālāya tañcassa atthaṃ anubhoti
an5.23:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcime cittassa upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṃgu ca na ca sammāsamādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya
an5.23:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca cittassa upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṃgu ca na ca sammāsamādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya
an5.23:2.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave cittaṃ imehi pañcahi upakkilesehi vimuttaṃ hoti taṃ hoti cittaṃ mudu ca kammaniyaṃ ca pabhassaraṃ ca na ca pabhaṃgu sammāsamādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya
an5.23:2.6: yassa yassa ca abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.23:3.1: so sace ākaṃkhati anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ ekopi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ bahudhāpi hutvā eko assaṃ āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gaccheyyaṃ seyyathāpi ākāse paṭhaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ kareyyaṃ seyyathāpi udake udakepi abhijjamāne gaccheyyaṃ seyyathāpi paṭhaviyā ākāsepi pallaṅkena kameyyaṃ seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo imepi candimasuriye evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmaseyyaṃ parimajjeyyaṃ yāvabrahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyanti
an5.23:3.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.23:4.1: so sace ākaṃkhati dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇeyyaṃ dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike cāti
an5.23:4.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.23:5.1: so sace ākaṃkhati parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.2: sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.3: vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.4: sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.5: vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ vītadosaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.6: samohaṃ vā cittaṃ samohaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.7: vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ vītamohaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.8: saṃkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ saṃkhittaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.9: vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ vikkhittaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.10: mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ mahaggataṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.11: amahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ amahaggataṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.12: sauttaraṃ vā cittaṃ sauttaraṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.13: anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ anuttaraṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.14: samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samāhitaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.15: asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ asamāhitaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.16: vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.17: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyyanti
an5.23:5.18: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.23:6.1: so sace ākaṃkhati anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyaṃ seyyathīdaṃ ekaṃpi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsaṃpi jātiyo tiṃsaṃpi jātiyo cattāḷīsaṃpi jātiyo paññāsaṃpi jātiyo jātisataṃpi jātisahassaṃpi jātisatasahassaṃpi anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto so tato cuto idhupapannoti iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyanti
an5.23:6.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.23:7.1: so sace ākaṃkhati dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammupage satte pajāneyyaṃ ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannāti iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammupage satte pajāneyyanti
an5.23:7.2: tatrakha tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.23:8.1: so sace ākaṃkhati āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyanti
an5.23:8.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyataneti.
